install.source: command -v go >/dev/null 2>&1 || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y golang-go git); BIN="$(go env GOPATH)/bin"; mkdir -p "$BIN"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"; git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/slicingmelon/gobypass403.git "$TMP" && (cd "$TMP" && go build -o "$BIN/gobypass403" ./cmd/gobypass403/); rm -rf "$TMP"
